api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the PagerDuty REST API v2 key

routing_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the service integration key for event triggers

from_email.description: Email address sent in the From header for PagerDuty write operations (acknowledge, resolve, add_note, create_incident)

default_service_id.description: Default PagerDuty service ID used when none is provided to create_incident
